feature: Filter chassis — one control on four routes
note:
Four routes the brief says carry the same filter control. Steps are plain `goto`s because every surface here is a page.

NO `shares` BLOCK YET, deliberately. All four routes already render `FilterChassis` — /decks directly, /commanders and /discover through the shared `FilterRack`, /collection through `FilterBar` — and composing a primitive that takes its controls as props behind a route-level assembler is the design working, not a defect. Pointing `shares.module` at the chassis therefore failed three routes for doing the right thing.

What is genuinely duplicated is the phone sheet: `DeckFilterSheet`, the rack's `FilterSheet` and `CollectionFilterSheet` are three implementations of one job, where the handoff (STATES §49, §157, §177-180) describes one sheet pattern whose CONTENTS vary by route. The ruling is one sheet component taking its dimensions as props.

WHEN IT LANDS, `view` HAS TO MOVE WITH IT. `check-shared-imports.mjs` reads each row's `view` directly and does not follow composition, so a `shares` block naming the new sheet while these rows still name the route views would reproduce exactly the false failures this inventory just removed — the wrappers will own the sheet import, not the views. The rule is that `view` names the file that RENDERS the shared component, which for the sheet means `rack/filter-rack.tsx` and `collection/filter-bar.tsx` rather than `commanders-view.tsx` and `browser.tsx`. The rows carry no `view` today for that reason: the right value depends on which component the block ends up naming.
